title: v2.payment.set_shop_installment_status
label: SHOPEE · API REFERENCE
html:
Sets the staging capability of shop level.

Request

Request Address

POST/api/v2/payment/set_shop_installment_status

Base URL: https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/payment/set_shop_installment_status
